artworks.title: Guardhouse
artworks.artist: Jean-Charles François after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner and softground etching printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows five men in a dimly lit interior. They are gathered around a table. The central figure in the foreground is slumped over with his head resting on the table, his hair covered by a helmet. The men around him are engaged in drinking and eating, with one holding a glass. They are dressed in historical or period clothing, with a mix of armor and tunics. The background features heavy beams and ropes. A large drum rests near one man, who is holding it with one leg propped on the table. Belts, straps, and various accoutrements are visible on the men.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.artist: Jan Gerritsz van Bronckhorst after Cornelis van Poelenburch
artworks.description: The image displays two figures, a woman and a child, both depicted from head to toe. The woman is seated, facing left with a slight torso turn, and the child stands leaning towards her. The woman has classical facial features, straight nose, defined lips, and styled hair. She is draped in a cloth. The child has cherubic features, small wings on his back, and holds a small bow, indicating a cupid figure. In the background are billowing clouds.

artworks.title: Battle between a Centaur and a Triton
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 11.5 x 16.6 cm (4 1/2 x 6 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures engaged in a battle. The scene depicts a struggle involving a centaur and two mermen. The centaur is rearing up with legs poised, one merman stands with his fish tail visible, and the other is engaged in a grappling match. Each creature brandishes a club, showcasing movement and conflict. The background features swirling clouds, horizon lines, and the outline of a landscape or rocky coast. The artist uses fine lines and shading to enhance muscle definition and texture of the creatures' bodies, emphasizing their mythical and powerful nature.

artworks.title: Erlangen Students on Horseback
artworks.description: This is a drawing of riders on horseback in an outdoor setting. The artwork depicts two horses prominently in the foreground, with their riders engaged in conversation while seated on their mounts. Both horses are depicted in detail, with their musculature and tack clearly defined. The riders appear to be wearing historical attire. In the background, there are additional horses and riders receding into the distance. The environment features a path or road, sparse vegetation, and a fallen tree. The background is lightly sketched, giving a sense of space and adding to the composition.

artworks.title: Outing on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing with three individuals on horseback, positioned slightly right of center, viewed from a profile perspective as they proceed down a curving path. The horizon sits low in the image, offering a view of distant, gently rolling hills and wide skies with some cloud formations. The style features fine line work characteristic of engravings, capturing intricate textures and shadows on both the figures and the terrain. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black, white, and grey. Closest to us, grassy and bushy elements line the path, adding texture and depth to the composition. Beyond the main figures, additional riders can be seen in the background, contributing to the sense of depth and continuity in the landscape.

artworks.title: The Four-Wheeled Cart
artworks.description: The image displays a cart hitched to a horse. Close by, a goose walks along a path, while the cart with large wheels is central to the scene. A man interacts with the horse near the cart filled with barrels and goods. To the left, a man on horseback and another figure are near a building's entrance with a thatched roof. Trees in the background and buildings are depicted with detailed etching techniques. The monochromatic palette captures textures through cross-hatching and stippling for shadow and depth.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut from 2 blocks in black and gray-brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to borderline): 26 x 20.6 cm (10 1/4 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The woodcut image depicts a woman looking down at a sleeping baby. The woman has closed eyes, gently styled hair, and is dressed in flowing robes. The baby has a halo around its head and is lying in the woman's lap. The background shows abstract forms and rays of light.

artworks.title: Proposal for the Trevi Fountain
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketched building with grand architecture. The horizon is not visible in the image. The sketch captures the architectural details with loose and quick brushstrokes. The color palette mainly consists of brown and gray tones. The façade is detailed, with hints of statues and a fountain in the center.

artworks.title: A Turk
artworks.medium: pastel on wove paper, mounted on board
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The person is positioned with their body turned slightly to the left, raising their right arm slightly. The facial features are blurred, with the head adorned by a white turban wrapped around darker hair. The person is wearing an elaborate blue garment with red and gold details, including draped fabric and a decorative belt or sash encircling the waist. The background is a soft pastel landscape with patches of blue, pink, and brown, evoking a cloudy sky and a distant horizon.

artworks.title: Oriental Interior with Sleeping Tiger
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on a daybed or couch. The person is positioned slightly leaning back, resting on their left arm, with their head tilted and looking towards the viewer. The facial features are not clearly visible due to the shadow and distance, and their hair appears to be covered by a cloth or cap. They are wearing a long, flowing gown. To the right of the person on the daybed, there is a decorative pillow with a large, ornate design. On the floor in front of the daybed lies a large animal skin rug. The background is dark and shadowy, providing a sense of depth and contrast to the lighter tones of the clothing and rug. The scene is surrounded by a plain cream-colored border.

artworks.title: Oriental Vignettes
artworks.description: The image shows two distinct scenes separated horizontally. In the top half, a person in a turban sits near an ox harnessed to a cart. A large building stands in the background, and small figures and horse riders are visible. In the bottom half, a camel covered in textiles is featured, along with a person carrying an animal. Another scene shows a woman with a covered head balancing a basket on her head, accompanied by a child. The artwork is detailed, using fine lines to create texture and depth in a monochromatic palette of gray shades.

artworks.title: Tigre en arrêt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large feline in a natural setting. The drawing depicts a feline crouched on the ground with its body positioned towards the viewer. Its tail is curved upward, and its expression is one of focus and alertness. The backdrop suggests a natural environment, sketched with trees or bushes and some foliage. The strokes are expressive and sketch-like, capturing the essence of motion and environment with minimal detail. The artist's signature, "Eug. Delacroix," can be seen at the bottom left of the drawing.

artworks.title: Femmes d'Alger
artworks.description: The image shows two women depicted in a detailed line drawing. Woman 1 is seated on a patterned sofa, leaning against it with her hand on her lap. She has distinct facial features, wears an updo with a headscarf, and is dressed in draped clothing with accessories. Woman 2 lies beside her, propped on one elbow and facing her. She has long hair and prominent facial features, wearing a decorative outfit with a visible necklace. In the background, there are decorations like a vase with flowers on a table and an archway with curtains. The setting suggests an opulent interior rich in textures and patterns.

artworks.title: Croquis (Two Arabian Figures)
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures positioned slightly side by side from about the knees up. The figure on the left is wearing a head covering and robes, with facial features that are not distinctly detailed. The figure on the right has more defined features, wearing a headscarf and loosely draped clothing. Both figures are holding objects in their hands. The background of the image is plain, presented in a sketch-like style with no distinct features, focusing attention on the two figures. The entire composition is rendered in a monochromatic color scheme, likely using etching techniques.

artworks.title: Tánger (Seated Arabs)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cloaked figures in a shadowy archway. The scene is depicted in a monochrome etching style, showcasing a group of cloaked figures who appear to be huddled together on the ground. The setting is slightly dilapidated with a large archway in the background casting shadows across the figures. The texture of the drawing is rich with intricate lines creating a play of light and shadow. Details in the etching suggest a rough and worn surface on the walls and floor. The composition is dense with textures, bringing emphasis to the robes and the surrounding architecture.

artworks.title: La République Française
artworks.artist: Monogrammist G.H. after Pierre Paul Prud'hon
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure standing upright. The individual holds a staff with a sculpted hand at the top in the left hand and a small pyramid with the word "EGALITÉ" inscribed on it in the right hand. The figure has classical facial features with a prominent nose, short curly hair bound with a headband, and a focused expression. They wear a short, draped tunic cinched at the waist with a belt, sandals with straps, and their ankles are chained to a rectangular wooden platform. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Costume de Paquita dans la Reine d'Espagne
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a relaxed position. She is shown from head to toe, with her left arm resting on an armrest and her right hand clutching her skirt. Her head is slightly tilted to the left. She has delicate features, full lips, and styled hair with a decorative headpiece or flowers. She wears an elaborate dress with a large structured bodice, intricate patterns, puffed sleeves, and cascading layers with tassel-like embellishments. A thin, transparent shawl or veil is draped over her shoulders. The background is minimally sketched, and she is positioned against an ornate surface.

artworks.title: Landscape with Sheep
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, a sky filled with clouds, and distant cliffs. The painting features trees, foliage, rocky outcrops, and sheep grazing on grass. The color scheme is warm and aged, dominated by sepia tones. Brushstrokes are detailed, creating texture on the trees and other elements in the scene.

artworks.title: Puits du Chateau de Nantes, Bretagne
artworks.description: The image shows a well with intricate ironwork at the center, placed on a circular stone base. Nearby, there is a grand building with ornate windows and detailed architectural features. In the distance, a smaller building with a tiled roof can be seen, with several individuals engaging in different activities. The sky is partially visible beyond the rooftops. The artwork uses precise lines to create a detailed texture, typical of a lithograph. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades of gray and black. Shadows are utilized to add depth and volume to the scene.

artworks.title: Man and Woman Descending Staircase
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, gothic-style interior with large windows and a grand staircase. The image shows a spacious hall with a vaulted ceiling supported by slender columns, adorned with intricate patterns and decorative elements. The staircase ascends in a gently curving manner, flanked by elegantly carved bannisters, leading up to a landing that is bathed in light streaming through tall, arched windows. The flooring is composed of large stone tiles, reflecting patches of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Fontaine de Jardin Borghese
artworks.description: The image shows a garden with a fountain as the central point. Lush trees cover the horizon creating a dense backdrop. A path to the left of the fountain leads deeper into the scene where a couple walks. Delicate brushstrokes give texture to the trees and foliage around the fountain. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with shades of gray. In the distance, trees of varying heights form curved shapes against the sky. Water arcs gracefully from the sculptural fountain. Figures dressed in period attire add historical charm to the scene.

artworks.title: Rustics Picnicking in Ruins
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky scene with ruins, figures, and a sloping hillside. The horizon is high in the composition, with sparse vegetation like bushes and trees. The brushstrokes are fine and intricate, creating texture and detail. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of gray, black, and white. In the foreground are the remains of a stone structure and two figures, with the terrain climbing upward with steps and stonework. In the distance, the landscape continues to rise, dotted with more remnants of ancient constructions.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: Pieter de Bailliu after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a natural setting. The figure on the left likely represents an angel, partially visible from the waist up, with one hand raised holding a cup and the other hand pointing towards the man. The figure has wings and flowing garments. The second figure, on the right, is sitting or kneeling on a rocky surface. This figure has long hair and a beard, facing the angel. He wears long, flowing robes and has his right hand placed on his chest, while his left hand rests on his knee. In the background, there is a large tree, clouds with rays of light, an evening sky, and faint outlines of buildings or structures in the distance.

artworks.title: Shepherd and Flock under an Ancient Tree
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral scene seen from an eye-level perspective. A flock of sheep is walking on a cobblestone path, with a large tree dominating the right side of the composition. The tree's trunk extends upwards and its branches spread across the upper part of the image. The artwork uses detailed etching to depict the tree bark, leaves, and the sheep's wooly texture. The horizon is in the middle distance, with trees and faint structures suggesting a rural landscape. The background shows more trees and delicate lines, creating a serene natural environment. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades created by the etching pattern to convey depth and texture, giving the image a timeless quality.
